quotes: Friday is when I need the money, not Monday
I wait three days for my money and my supplier wants cash today
Settlement takes too long, I need cash to restock
patterns.summary: Traders need faster settlement to restock and meet supplier payment demands, especially before high-volume trading periods.

quotes: I already pay half a percent, so a bit more for same day is fine
If it came the same day I would pay something small, maybe fifty naira
patterns.summary: At least two traders indicated they would accept a small fee for same-day settlement, including one who already pays for POS services.

quotes: We stopped recommending anybody after the loan app wahala
Talk to the traders one by one, not the association
patterns.summary: An association secretary said the association no longer recommends vendors and expects NovaPay to approach traders individually.

quotes: My POS provider never answers when a payout is stuck
Charges are hidden until the money lands
Settlement takes too long, I need cash to restock
patterns.summary: Customers are frustrated by slow settlement, unresponsive providers, and charges that are not disclosed upfront.

contradictions.summary: Trader interviews indicate demand and willingness to pay for same-day settlement, while the association source rejects the assumption that the association will promote NovaPay and instead recommends individual outreach.

suggestions.reason: Two traders explicitly said they would pay a small fee for same-day settlement, and the broader evidence shows that delayed payouts create real restocking pressure. This is promising but based on only two direct pricing responses, so it is not yet validated.
suggestions.assumption_statement: Market traders will pay a small fee for same-day settlement

suggestions.reason: The market association secretary explicitly said the association no longer recommends vendors and told NovaPay to approach traders individually, directly refuting the assumption that market associations will promote NovaPay to their members.
suggestions.assumption_statement: Market associations will promote NovaPay to their members
